validation.reason: The compositional specification validates, resolves a checked-in public reference profile, one declared standard LeRobot v2 input, or an explicit trusted custom-data contract through four serial runtime tasks, trains matched ordinary-BC and feedback-weighted policies from the same base, and production-renders the digest-pinned CUDA image without materializing credentials.
evidence: npa workbench workflow plan-spec workflows/testing/groot-n15-offline-rl.yaml --run-id groot-n15-plan --var bucket=example-bucket --check-render --json

task_fidelity.reason: Hermetic tests bind a declarative no-code LeRobot input, safe content-addressed extension installation, observed outcome/progress/recovery feedback, collection-group isolation, train-only statistics, terminal action masks, matched ordinary-BC/control identity, finite offline metric handling, native command contracts, reusable checkpoint identity, and an offline HTML/gallery artifact contract. They do not establish CUDA execution or policy improvement.

output_storage.reason: The checked-in bucket is a placeholder. A run needs a writable task-owned bucket and a unique run prefix before submission.

worker_input.reason: The shipped reference profile downloads two pinned redistributable public sources and emits its own provenance/action/feedback/gallery contracts. The standard no-code mode reads one worker-readable declaration binding a LeRobot v2 source tree, feedback sidecar, field mapping, action semantics, split and model identities. Custom input still requires an explicit content-addressed worker-readable archive, provenance/action contract, and trusted code archive/package/callables; its adapter must emit native LeRobot v2 bytes, decoded video, and an H.264 derivative before training.

credentials.reason: Every execution must freshly check project storage access and runtime access to the exact model revision. No credential or infrastructure identity is stored here.

source_image.reason: The committed CUDA image digest and runtime-only source/model pins are render-valid; each execution must stage its source revision and verify image pullability plus SM120 compatibility on its selected worker.

target_runtime.reason: No static record can qualify a future GPU placement. The submitted run must independently prove one visible RTX PRO 6000, CUDA capability sm_120, native decord observation decoding, finite optimizer updates, checkpoint reload, held-out inference, and durable artifact readback.
